propositions: Implement four read-only, deterministic metric functions in git_metrics.py: module_size_distribution, cap_change_events, churn, and refactor_to_addition_ratio derived from git history and the working tree.
module_size_distribution scans src/rebar/**/*.py line counts against the single-sourced hard cap in .github/module-size-limit.txt and returns count, near_cap_count, over_cap_count, and max_loc.
cap_change_events reads git log history of .github/module-size-limit.txt and returns a list of commit/old_limit/new_limit dicts, or an empty list if no cap changes occurred in the range.
churn and refactor_to_addition_ratio are computed from git log --numstat, with the ratio returning None when total insertions is zero.
Register all four metrics into the c085 REGISTRY with lens=code_health, source=git, confidence=high via single-arg adapter computes that pull range from context.
Unit tests verify exact-value assertions on module_size_distribution, churn, refactor_to_addition_ratio, and cap_change_events against fixture git repos.
